实现者过程与运行背景 · 14 个过程问题 / 2 条建议 · 不自动归为框架问题

本任务已处理只描述应用侧处理结果，不代表 NocoBase3 上游已修复。

本轮过程记录

Built the equipment after-sales service and inspection collaboration system as application-owned NocoBase 3 source: 7 immutable migrations, 4 idempotent seeds, a ServiceDomainProvider service, an /api/service Hono route surface, one source-managed acceptance Workflow, 11 client pages/routes, bilingual strings, and business tests. Repair round 1: the production dist was not loadable because server/providers/service-domain.ts imported SERVICE_DOMAIN_SERVICE_KEY from the workflow package contract; moved the key into server/service/constants.ts so the compiled provider no longer reaches into the materialized Workflow Artifact. Repair round 2 fixed the observed browser-acceptance defects: the work-order detail route was unreachable because the child path was declared absolute under a parent (doubling the segment) and the parent never rendered Outlet; a new work order was auto-accepted instead of waiting for a supervisor and the list had no accept entry; a duplicate device serial surfaced as a raw 500 instead of a readable 409; a work order could bind a device to a different customer than its owner; required-field failures only showed a toast; identity Selects showed numeric ids; the header had no message center; and the integration entry pointed its API-key link at a dead path and lacked the page/device grants behind it; and the reachable detail page would have exposed internal handling remarks to an observer; the attachment area offered only a download link, with no way to preview the real PNG and DOCX content, and an uploaded file's claimed type was never checked against its bytes. Server behavior is now covered by tests/logic/service-domain.test.ts (13 passing) and the shell/routes/locale coverage tests still pass. Repair round 3: the header message bell assumed app.services is always present, so the three layout-i18n shell tests crashed on a minimal ClientApplication mock with Cannot read properties of undefined (reading has); the bell now guards the service lookup with optional chaining and stays hidden where the notification-in-app runtime is absent.

问题 01 · 修复阶段

Production dist could not start: the service provider imported the workflow package contract

本任务已处理

pnpm build completed and wrote dist/server/standalone.js, but nocobase start printed 'Missing dist/server/standalone.js. Run pnpm build first.' and exited 1, so browser acceptance never began.

原因（实现者自述）
server/providers/service-domain.ts imported SERVICE_DOMAIN_SERVICE_KEY from ../workflows/work-order-acceptance/contract.js. The workflow plugin's afterServerBuild step removes dist/server/workflows and writes only hash-named Artifact directories, so the tsc-emitted dist/server/workflows/work-order-acceptance/contract.js no longer existed and the compiled provider failed to resolve it. The app-cli start script catches any ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND from importing dist/server/standalone.js and always reports the standalone file as missing, which hid the real nested missing module.
处理方式
Moved the canonical SERVICE_DOMAIN_SERVICE_KEY into server/service/constants.ts and import it there from server/providers/service-domain.ts. Left server/workflows/work-order-acceptance/contract.ts self-contained with its own identical literal (its Run module is loaded from inside the materialized Artifact, where an import leaving the package does not resolve), with a comment tying the two values together. pnpm build succeeds, importing dist/server/standalone.js resolves, pnpm start reaches 'App server listening', and tests/logic/service-domain.test.ts passes including the acceptance Workflow run node.
影响 / 代价：未提供，不估算来源：Agent · retro.json
问题 02 · 修复阶段

Work-order detail was unreachable and the list had no accept/process entry

本任务已处理

Clicking a work-order number changed the URL to /main (Home); /main/service/work-orders/1 redirected to /main; the duplicated child route /main/service/work-orders/service/work-orders/1 rendered only the list. The list rows had no accept/process control, so acceptance and every later lifecycle step could not be performed.

原因（实现者自述）
client/routes.ts declared the child path as '/service/work-orders/:id' while the parent already contributed '/service/work-orders', producing the doubled segment; and client/pages/service/work-orders/index.tsx never rendered an <Outlet/>, so the matched child had nowhere to mount even when the path matched.
处理方式
Changed the child path to ':id' (relative), rendered <Outlet/> at the end of the list PageContainer, and converted the detail page to <RouteChildPage><PageContainer/></RouteChildPage> with <Breadcrumbs/> instead of a manual 'back to list' link. Added breadcrumb titles on both routes (service.workOrders.title / service.workOrders.detailTitle). Row links are now relative with the current search preserved, and rows gained an inline supervisor Accept button plus an Open link so the first lifecycle step no longer depends on the detail page. Covered by tests/logic/client-routes.test.ts and the shell/route-navigation tests.
影响 / 代价：未提供，不估算来源：Agent · retro.json
问题 03 · 修复阶段

A new work order was accepted automatically instead of waiting for a supervisor

本任务已处理

A work order created through New work order appeared directly as 'Ready to process' (待处理) instead of 待受理, so the supervisor acceptance step and its normal/urgent branch never ran against a pending order.

原因（实现者自述）
createWorkOrder called acceptWorkOrder(auto:true) and triggerAcceptanceWorkflow itself, so acceptance happened inside creation rather than as an explicit supervisor action.
处理方式
createWorkOrder now returns the order in 待受理 and only logs the creation activity. applyTransition('accept') performs the acceptance: it calls acceptWorkOrder(orderId, userId, {auto:false}) directly (assigning the engineer and notifying them through the idempotency key work-order:<id>:accepted) and then triggers the acceptance Workflow so its run/step/branch remains inspectable. A replayed accept is refused by the state machine (409) without a second notification. tests/logic/service-domain.test.ts now asserts pending_accept on creation, pending_process and dispatchCount 1 after acceptance, and dispatchCount still 1 after a replayed accept.
影响 / 代价：未提供，不估算来源：Agent · retro.json
问题 04 · 修复阶段

A duplicate device serial number returned 500 instead of a readable 409

本任务已处理

Saving a device with an existing serial number showed 'Internal Server Error'; POST /api/service/devices returned 500 three times rather than a readable uniqueness rejection.

原因（实现者自述）
saveDevice let the database unique constraint fail through to the route error handler. @nocobase/db exports its isUniqueConstraintViolation helper only from a non-public deep path, so the provider had no supported way to translate the raw violation into a domain error.
处理方式
saveDevice now pre-checks for an existing device with the same serial number and a different id and throws ServiceDomainError('DEVICE_SERIAL_DUPLICATE', ..., 409); it also wraps create/update in a local isUniqueViolation(error) check (walking cause/originalError and matching errCode -6602, SQLSTATE 23505, ER_DUP_ENTRY, and the SQLite/MySQL/MSSQL constraint codes) that converts a raced violation into the same 409. The route's onError returns {code, message} as JSON. tests/logic/service-domain.test.ts asserts the 409 code and message.
影响 / 代价：未提供，不估算来源：Agent · retro.json
问题 05 · 修复阶段

A work order could attach a device to a different customer

本任务已处理

POST /api/service/work-orders with {customerId:4, deviceId:5} returned 201 and created WO-20260928-0001 even though device 5 belongs to customer 3, silently detaching the device from its owner.

原因（实现者自述）
createWorkOrder accepted an explicit customerId without checking it against the selected device's customerId.
处理方式
createWorkOrder now refuses a mismatch with ServiceDomainError('CUSTOMER_DEVICE_MISMATCH', ..., 409) before deriving the effective customer. tests/logic/service-domain.test.ts asserts the 409 code/message for a mismatch and a 201 for the matching pair, so the check is not over-broad.
影响 / 代价：未提供，不估算来源：Agent · retro.json
问题 06 · 修复阶段

Required-field failures showed only a toast, and identity Selects showed numeric ids

本任务已处理

With a required device field empty, Save sent no POST and left the dialog open, but there was no visible required-field text in the dialog. Customer/device Selects displayed the stored numeric id (e.g. 4) instead of the customer or device name.

原因（实现者自述）
Client validation reported failures only through useToaster(), and Selects were rendered from <SelectItem> children without the Base UI `items` value-to-label map that SelectValue needs to render the selected option.
处理方式
Device, customer, work-order-create and integration forms now keep field-level error state and render an aria-invalid control plus a visible <p role='alert' className='text-sm text-destructive'> message beside the field (server failures land in the same dialog and as a toast). Every identity-backed Select now receives an items array of {value,label}, which Base UI resolves for the trigger. Verified by typecheck and the route/shell tests; the inline rendering itself is a browser-acceptance item.
影响 / 代价：未提供，不估算来源：Agent · retro.json
问题 07 · 修复阶段

The header had no message center entry or page

本任务已处理

The top bar had no message/notification button, the account menu only had Language and Sign out, and no page in the app searched to message/消息/notification/通知, so durable in-app messages were not reachable.

原因（实现者自述）
The application registered the notification-in-app plugin but never exposed its inbox: no route, no navigation entry, and no header control.
处理方式
Added the /service/messages route (auth required, authz skip because the inbox is per-actor) rendering PageContainer > NotificationInAppProvider > NotificationInAppInbox, and a MessageBell in header-actions that wraps the provider, links to the inbox, and shows the provider's unread count. The bell hides itself when the notification-in-app runtime service is absent, so the application shell does not depend on the plugin's service in a minimal context. Messages now resolve once and navigate to the real inbox.
影响 / 代价：未提供，不估算来源：Agent · retro.json
问题 08 · 修复阶段

The integration user could not reach API-key management or list devices

本任务已处理

Device integration's 'Manage API keys' link pointed at /main/api-keys and fell back to Home; /main/settings/api-keys showed 'No settings available' for the integration user. GET /main/api/service/devices returned 403, so the integration report form's Device dropdown was empty and the form could not be submitted.

原因（实现者自述）
The link used a path that is not a route (the API Keys plugin mounts its page at /settings/api-keys), and the integration permission set lacked page('api-keys') access and serviceDevices view, so the settings tree and device list were both filtered out.
处理方式
The page now links to /settings/api-keys. The integration permission set gains page('api-keys') access and serviceDevices view (reference-scoped), and database/main/seeds/202609260002_service_permissions.ts reconciles the stored integration grants against the code definition so an upgraded application picks the change up without touching other sets' admin edits.
影响 / 代价：未提供，不估算来源：Agent · retro.json
问题 09 · 修复阶段

Overdue reminders counted notifications that had no valid recipient

本任务已处理

sendOverdueReminders reported one more reminder than notification_dispatches rows: one dispatch failed with 'In-app to must contain application user IDs.' while still incrementing the sent count.

原因（实现者自述）
An order created for a device without a service engineer stored assigneeId as '' rather than NULL: asText(null) returns '' and the ?? null normalization treats '' as present. sendOverdueReminders then treated '' as a real recipient and attempted a notification.
处理方式
Identity columns are now normalized through optionalString so a null/empty engineerId leaves assigneeId null in createWorkOrder, acceptWorkOrder and defaultAssigneeFor, and sendOverdueReminders skips an order whose assignee is absent or empty. tests/logic/service-domain.test.ts verifies sent === dispatchCount for the day.
影响 / 代价：未提供，不估算来源：Agent · retro.json
问题 10 · 修复阶段

An observer could read internal handling remarks on an order timeline

本任务已处理

Once the work-order detail route became reachable, an observer opening a permitted non-confidential order received the full activity timeline, including the free-text remarks staff add through the comment action, which the read-only role must not see.

原因（实现者自述）
orderDetail returned every serviceWorkOrderActivities row for anyone who could read the order, without separating the internal handling note (ACTIVITY_ACTIONS.commented) from the status history.
处理方式
orderDetail now omits commented activities for the observer and the external integration roles, while the supervisor and the assigned engineer keep the full timeline. tests/logic/service-domain.test.ts adds a case that posts an internal remark, confirms the supervisor sees it, and confirms the observer does not.
影响 / 代价：未提供，不估算来源：Agent · retro.json
问题 11 · 修复阶段

Attachments could not be previewed and a corrupted file was stored without a real failure

本任务已处理

The work-order detail attachment area listed files with a download link only. A PNG showed a thumbnail, but a DOCX had no preview, so the acceptance requirement to preview the real content of both formats could not be met. A file whose bytes did not match its claimed type was stored anyway, so a corrupted file produced no real failure.

原因（实现者自述）
The detail page never used the preinstalled application-owned FilePreviewDialog, and the upload route validated only the declared extension and MIME type, never the content signature. The order detail also returned bare attachment link rows without the stored file metadata a preview needs.
处理方式
orderDetail now joins filename/ext/mimeType/size onto each attachment, the detail page maps them to FileRecord objects, shows an in-progress indicator while an upload runs, and renders a Preview action through FilePreviewDialog from client/extensions/nocobase-file-component-ui (the OOXML viewer renders DOCX). The upload route rejects a file whose bytes are not a PNG signature or a ZIP/OOXML container with a 415 INVALID_FILE_CONTENT. tests/logic/service-domain.test.ts asserts the returned file metadata and both corrupted-file refusals.
影响 / 代价：未提供，不估算来源：Agent · retro.json
问题 12 · 修复阶段

Reported observer visibility of a confidential work order did not reproduce

本任务已处理

The browser acceptance observed the observer account's work-order list showing all rows and identified the confidential WO-2026-0005 (Confidential) as visible, which would mean the observer read scope leaked an internal order.

原因（实现者自述）
readableOrderIds already returns only rows whose confidential flag is falsy for a pure observer, and the observer account is assigned only the service-observer permission set in the seeded database. The observed seven rows equal the five non-confidential seed orders plus the two QA-created non-confidential orders, so WO-2026-0005 was not actually in the observer's list.
处理方式
No code change. Confirmed against the seeded database (observer holds only service-observer and WO-2026-0005 has confidential=1) and by tests/logic/service-domain.test.ts, which asserts the observer list contains no confidential order while the supervisor list does, so the check is not vacuous. The same non-disclosure is asserted for the order detail and for sharing a confidential order.
影响 / 代价：未提供，不估算来源：Agent · retro.json
问题 13 · 修复阶段

Real-browser rendering of the service pages is not exercised by the agent

处理结果未提供

No Playwright/Chromium is available in the repair environment, so the service pages were never rendered in a real browser.

原因（实现者自述）
Environment limitation, not an application defect.
处理方式
Proxies used: the client-routes test imports every page module in jsdom, the shell/route-navigation tests render the application layout, and typecheck covers the client/server/node projects. Left for the factory's browser acceptance step to confirm.

问题 14 · 修复阶段

The header message bell crashed the shell layout tests on a minimal app context

本任务已处理

tests/components/layout-i18n.test.tsx failed all three shell-translation cases with TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading has) at client/layouts/components/message-bell.tsx:35, so the header, footer, tooltips and settings/dev page headers could not be asserted.

原因（实现者自述）
MessageBell called app.services.has(realtimeClientToken) directly. The test builds a partial ClientApplication ({config, runtime}) without services, so the property was undefined and the guard threw instead of hiding the bell.
处理方式
Changed the guard to app.services?.has(realtimeClientToken), so a context without a service resolver renders nothing as intended and the real application still checks the notification-in-app runtime. Ran vitest on tests/components/layout-i18n.test.tsx (5 passed) plus the other header-action consumers tests/components/app-layout-routes.test.tsx and tests/logic/client-settings.test.tsx (30 passed); eslint, prettier and tsc --noEmit pass for the change.
影响 / 代价：未提供，不估算来源：Agent · retro.json

实现者补充建议

来自可选过程笔记，不代表已独立确认；相同建议引用上方评审，其余保留原文。

建议 01 · 工具与构建

A nested module resolution failure is reported as a missing standalone entry

需人工判断

The @nocobase/app-cli start script catches ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND from importing dist/server/standalone.js and unconditionally prints 'Missing dist/server/standalone.js. Run pnpm build first.', which names the entry file even when the missing module is a nested import inside the server graph. This sent the first repair pass at the build output instead of the import graph.

建议改动

In @nocobase/app-cli start.mjs, check that the standalone entry itself exists before importing, and let a nested ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND surface the original missing specifier instead of rewriting it to the standalone-file message.

来源：Agent · retro.json

建议 02 · correctness

Nullable identity columns coerce to empty strings through a text helper

可自动化

asText(value, fallback = '') returns '' for null, and call sites that combine it with `?? null` keep the empty string because ?? only replaces null/undefined. The result is stored as an empty-string identifier or notification recipient, which is neither a valid id nor absent, and only surfaces later as a rejected notification or a broken filter.

建议改动

Normalize optional identity values through a single helper that maps null, undefined and empty/whitespace strings to null (or undefined) before writing, and use it for every foreign-key and assignee column.

来源：Agent · retro.json

原始验收要求

主管创建客户与设备，刷新后关联正确；重复设备编号、必填缺失、报修时客户设备不匹配均被拒绝。未登录者不能读取或写入业务。

实际操作

  1. 以主管(supervisor)账号登录后打开 Service/Customers，点击 New customer 先空表保存，再创建客户 验收客户-A 并保存。
  2. 打开 Service/Devices 点击 New device，先空表保存；再填入设备编号 QA-DEV-X-001 与名称但故意不选所属客户后保存；随后选择客户 验收客户-A、工程师 李工 并填入已存在的设备编号 NX200-A-001 保存；最后改为唯一编号 QA-DEV-X-001 保存并刷新 Devices 列表。
  3. 在 Service/Work orders 打开 New work order，选择客户 验收客户-A 与属于其他客户的设备 NX200-A-0001 后保存；再将客户改为 西南能源装备有限公司 并选择停用设备 GY300-C-0202 保存。
  4. 用无会话浏览器打开 /main/service/customers，并用 curl 在未携带会话时 GET 与 POST /main/api/service/devices。

观察结果

  1. 客户名称必填被拒：表单显示 A customer name is required；创建 验收客户-A 后列表出现该客户并显示 Saved。
  2. 设备编号/名称必填被拒；重复编号被拒并显示 设备编号 NX200-A-0001 已存在，请使用唯一编号。
  3. 设备 所属客户 未选择时保存未做客户端必填校验，POST /main/api/service/devices 返回 HTTP 500，表单仅显示 Internal Server Error；服务端日志为 RepositoryError: Resolved value is invalid for Field "customerId"。这是非预期 5xx/未处理异常。
  4. 有效设备 QA-DEV-X-001 保存成功，刷新后行内容为 QA-DEV-X-001|验收设备X|验收客户-A|李工|Enabled，关联正确。
  5. 报修客户与设备不匹配被拒：所选设备不属于该客户，无法创建工单；停用设备被拒：The device is disabled and cannot receive work orders。
  6. 未登录：页面跳转到 /main/login；GET 与 POST /main/api/service/devices 均返回 HTTP 401 UNAUTHORIZED。
